Council memo: six-story mixed-use building with up to 70 residential condominiums and nine commercial condominiums, one podium and one basement parking level; demolishes an existing residence, barn and accessory buildings and removes 30 ordinance-size and 19 non-ordinance trees. EIR found significant unavoidable impacts on cultural resources (historic residence and barn) requiring a Statement of Overriding Considerations. Applicant requested a parking reduction with a TDM plan.
SF YIMBY: 48,250 sq ft garage; 131 homes in total across this project and the adjacent 1073-1087 South Winchester project.
